information: We are excited to host this competition as a Warm-Up for the [Rubik's WCA North American Championship 2024!](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NAC2024) All competitors are welcome - you do not need to be registered for the Rubik's WCA North American Championship to compete at this competition.
